rules.title: Launch first, then get
rules.text: Do not call ray.get inside the loop that launches tasks. Launch every task first, then call ray.get once on the list of refs.

rules.title: ray.put large arguments
rules.text: Pass a large shared argument by reference: call ray.put once and pass the object ref to each task.

rules.title: Sensible task size
rules.text: Avoid launching huge numbers of tiny tasks. Batch work so each task amortizes scheduling overhead.

rules.title: Declare resources
rules.text: Declare num_cpus, num_gpus and memory for tasks and actors so the scheduler can place them.

rules.title: Timeouts on waits
rules.text: Pass timeouts to ray.get and ray.wait when waiting on work that may hang.

rules.title: Actors for state
rules.text: Use actors for stateful services and plain tasks for stateless work.

rules.title: Keep docs URLs stable
rules.text: Renaming or moving a public API changes its documentation URL. Add redirects when you do.
